blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Remote sensing change detection (RSCD) is essential for monitoring land-cover changes and urban development. However, most methods demand pixel-level change masks, which are costly and time-consuming to annotate. Weakly supervised methods reduce this cost by using image-level change labels. Yet these labels indicate only whether a change occurs, leaving models to recover the location of the change and semantic meaning through additional and complex mechanisms. This missing information can be supplied directly by change captions, which describe what changes, what it becomes, and where it occurs. Therefore, we introduce change-caption-guided RSCD, using change captions as the sole task-specific supervision to learn change masks without manually annotated change masks. Our framework has two components: a caption-driven generation pipeline that produces bi-temporal remote sensing image pairs at scale with controlled changes matching each caption, and a change detector guided by the caption’s transition semantics. The detector uses our Semantic-Appearance Agreement Framework (SAAF) to combine caption-grounded semantic responses with RGB differences for change localization, while text conditioning guides dense prediction. Experiments on our newly constructed Flair-RSGen dataset and WHU-CDC show that SAAF outperforms the closest reproduced limited-supervision baselines in macro-averaged IoU and F1 under the evaluated protocols. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/qianyuancs/SAAF .
blocks.zh: 遥感变化探测对监测土地覆盖的变化和城市发展至关重要。 然而,大多数方法都需要像素级变化口罩,对注释来说,这些口罩既昂贵又费时. 受弱监督的方法通过使用图像级别改变标签来降低这一成本. 然而这些标签仅表明是否发生了变化,留下模型通过额外的复杂机制来恢复变化的位置和语义意义. 这种缺失的信息可以通过更改标题直接提供,这些标题描述什么变化,它变成什么,以及它在哪里发生. 因此,我们采用了变化封装制导的RSCD,使用变化标题作为唯一针对特定任务的监督来学习改变口罩而无需手动附加说明的改变口罩. 我们的框架有两个组成部分:一个由标题驱动的生成管道,它能产生规模上的双时空遥感图像配对,并带有与每个标题相匹配的可控变化,另一个由标题的过渡语义指导的改变探测器。 探测器使用我们的语义-语义协议框架(SAAF),将字幕基于语义的响应与RGB差异结合起来,用于改变本地化,而文本条件则指导密集预测. 对我们新构建的Flair-RSGen数据集和WHU-CDC的实验显示,SAAF在经过评价的协议下,在宏观平均IoU和F1中超过了最接近复制的有限监督基线。 守则可在https://github.com/qianyuancs/SAAF上公开查阅。 。 。 。

blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Remote-sensing change detection (RSCD) identifies
land-surface changes from co-registered images acquired over the
same geographical area at different times. By providing spatially
explicit information and temporally comparable information on surface evolution, RSCD supports urban
growth and land-use planning [ 1 ] , environmental
monitoring [ 2 ] , and rapid post-disaster
building-damage assessment [ 3 ] , thereby facilitating timely and informed decision-making.

blocks.en:
Fully convolutional Siamese networks learn paired representations for change prediction [ 4 ] . BIT models spatial–temporal context through compact visual tokens [ 5 ] , while ChangeFormer uses a hierarchical Transformer in a Siamese architecture [ 6 ] . Despite these advances, training accurate supervised RSCD models commonly requires manually delineated pixel-level change masks.
Constructing such masks is labor-intensive because annotators must
compare two temporal observations, distinguish genuine land-cover
transitions from seasonal or radiometric variations, and delineate
the boundaries of changed regions. This substantial annotation cost has motivated increasing interest in weakly supervised RSCD, in which predictions are learned from less expensive supervisory signals [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] .

prompts for segmentation-model refinement [ 10 ] . These
methods have substantially reduced the dependence of RSCD on change-mask annotations for training.

Nevertheless, binary scene-level supervision only indicates whether
a change exists in an image pair. It does not explicitly describe
which land-cover category disappears, which category emerges, or the
semantic direction of the transition. Consequently, existing methods
must infer both the spatial location and the semantic identity of a
change from image appearance and internal activations alone. They then require more complex models. Their
localization responses also can be distracted by seasonal
variation, illumination differences, phenological changes, or
residual image misregistration, even when no semantically relevant
transition has occurred.

Change captions encode transition semantics unavailable in a binary
changed/unchanged label. For example, the caption “farmland changes
to built-up land” identifies the disappearing source class and the
emerging target class, thereby specifying the direction of change.
Recent vision–language RSCD methods incorporate textual cues through

developed under fully or semi-supervised settings and still use
pixel-level change masks to optimize the change predictor. In
contrast, change-captioning methods map bi-temporal images to textual
descriptions [ 14 , 15 ] , rather than captions
to change maps.

In this work, we investigate a new RSCD setting in which a
sample-specific change caption serves as the sole supervisory
annotation for training, without change-mask supervision. Compared
with binary image-level labels, change captions provide
source-to-target semantics while avoiding the costly collection of
pixel-level change masks. The key challenge is to transform this
spatially weak semantic description into reliable pixel-level
evidence: A change caption specifies the transition and may
provide coarse spatial cues, but it does not delineate
the changed pixels.

blocks.en:
To address this challenge, we propose the Semantic-Appearance
Agreement Framework ( SAAF ). It employs a frozen,
remote-sensing-adapted Text-grounded Contrastive Learning model
(TCL-DA), built upon CLIP, as a pseudo-mask teacher to associate the
source-to-target semantics of a change caption with the bi-temporal
images [ 16 ] . The resulting semantic responses are combined with
temporal appearance differences to generate caption-consistent pseudo
change masks. These masks supervise a bi-temporal detector, while
the same caption further conditions its feature learning. In this
way, SAAF converts spatially weak change captions into
supervision by connecting what transition is described with where observable change occurs.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Remote-Sensing Change Detection Under Limited Supervision
blocks.zh: II-A 有限监督下的遥感变化探测

blocks.en: Limited-supervision RSCD methods must recover spatial and semantic information that coarse labels do not provide. They then often rely on more complex models. For example, WSLCD combines image-level labels with self-supervised representations [ 7 ] . ACWCD and TransWCD refine activation maps with Transformer attention, change priors, and scene-adaptive constraints [ 8 , 9 ] . BDFR-Net uses background consistency to separate and refine foreground responses, while BARNet adds teacher–student distillation and boundary-aware refinement [ 18 , 19 ] . SemSAM-CD converts activation peaks and boxes into segmentation prompts [ 10 ] . AdvCP, SemiCD-VL, and SCM use adversarial prompts, vision–language priors, or target-label-free inference [ 20 , 21 , 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 有限监督 RSCD方法必须回收粗细标签不提供的空间和语义信息. 然后,它们往往依赖更复杂的模型。 例如,WSLCD将图像级标签与自我监督的表示式结合[7]. ACWCD和TransWCD 精细化激活图,并带有变形器的注意力,变化前缀,以及场景适应性约束[8,9]. BDFR-Net使用背景一致性来区分和完善前景反应,而BARNet则增加了师生蒸馏和边界感知精炼[18,19]. SemSAM-CD将激活峰和箱转换成分块提示[10]. AdvCP,SemiCD-VL,和SCM使用对抗提示,视觉-语言前传,或目标无标签推断[20, 21, 22].

blocks.en: These methods derive locations from image features or pretrained visual priors, and their image-level labels do not specify the semantic transition; existing refinement methods mainly improve the completeness or boundary quality of class activation maps, and cannot recover transition information that is absent from the supervision itself. In particular, a changed scene may contain several land-cover categories and several radiometric differences, while the binary label treats them alike. SAAF, in contrast, turns each ordered change caption into transition-specific spatial supervision, narrowing the task to one source-to-target event before spatial localization begins.
blocks.zh: 这些方法从图像特征或预先训练的视觉前缀中衍生出位置,其图像级别标签没有指定语义过渡;现有的完善方法主要提高了类激活地图的完整性或边界质量,无法恢复监督本身所没有的过渡信息. 特别是,改变后的场景可能包含若干陆地覆盖类别和若干辐射度差异,而二进制标签则对两者一视同仁. 相比之下,SAAF将每个命令的更改标题变为特定过渡的空间监督,在空间定位开始前将任务缩小为一个源到目标的事件.

blocks.en: II-B Vision–Language and Caption-Aware Change Detection
blocks.zh: II-B 远景 - 语言和说明 - 注意变化检测

blocks.en: CLIP established scalable image–text representation learning [ 23 ] . RemoteCLIP and GeoRSCLIP adapt this principle to remote sensing [ 24 , 25 ] . SkyScript expands remote-sensing image–text pretraining data, while SkySense-O and CLIP2RS extend language-guided recognition to spatial interpretation [ 26 , 27 , 28 ] . These studies motivate domain-adapted text grounding but do not address caption-supervised bi-temporal change detection.
blocks.zh: CLIP建立了可伸缩图像–文本表现学习[23]. 远程CLIP和GeoRSCLIP使这一原则适应遥感[24,25]. SkyScript扩展了遥感图像–文本预训数据,而SkySense-O和CLIP2RS则将语言引导识别扩展至空间解释[26,27,28]. 这些研究激发了适合域的文本定位,但没有解决字幕监督的双时变化检测.

blocks.en: Language-guided prediction provides a link between image–text learning and spatial localization. GroupViT learns semantic grouping from image–text supervision [ 29 ] , and MaskCLIP extracts responses from pretrained CLIP features [ 30 ] . LSeg aligns pixel features with text embeddings [ 31 ] , DenseCLIP introduces pixel–text matching and contextual prompts [ 32 ] , and CLIPSeg predicts regions specified by text or image prompts [ 33 ] . Their supervision settings differ: language-guided inference does not itself imply training without labels. These studies also mainly concern concepts in a single image. RSCD requires evidence that the named source-to-target transition occurs across two dates.
blocks.zh: 语言引导预测提供了图像-文本学习和空间本地化之间的联系. GroupViT从图像–文本监管[29]中学习语义分组,MaskCLIP从预先训练的CLIP特性中提取响应[30]. LSeg 将像素特性与文本嵌入[31], DenseCLIP 引入像素-文本匹配和上下文提示 [32], CLIPSeg 预测文本或图像提示指定的区域 [33]. 它们的监督设置不同:语言指导推论本身并不意味着没有标签的培训。 这些研究还主要涉及单一形象的概念。 RSCD要求有证据表明,所命名的源到目标的过渡发生在两个日期之间.

blocks.en:
Vision–language RSCD methods use text in several ways. ChangeCLIP predicts changes from a fixed land-cover vocabulary [ 11 ] ; MDS-Net retrieves prompts from a predefined bank [ 12 ] ; and referring change detection localizes changes specified by a query [ 13 ] . Their predictors still learn from spatial labels. Although these methods incorporate textual semantics into change detection, text mainly serves as an auxiliary condition for feature learning, while their change predictors are still trained with real or generated change masks. They therefore do not address whether a
change detector can be trained from change captions alone.
blocks.zh:
远景-语言 RSCD方法以几种方式使用文本. ChangeCLIP从固定土地覆盖词汇中预测变化[11];MDS-Net从一个预定义的银行中检索提示[12];并引用变化检测将查询指定的变化本地化[13]. 他们的预测器仍然学习空间标签. 虽然这些方法将文字语义纳入变换检测中,但文字主要作为特征学习的辅助条件,而其变换预测器仍然用真实的或生成的变换口罩来训练. 因此,它们没有涉及是否
更改检测器可以从更改标题中单独培训。

blocks.en: SAAF uses a different supervision path. It receives an image pair and an ordered change caption, grounds the caption in both dates, verifies the response with appearance change, and trains the detector without reference masks.
blocks.zh: SAAF使用不同的监督路径. 它收到一对图像和一个命令的更改标题,在两个日期中按下标题,用外观改变来验证反应,并训练没有参考面具的探测器.

blocks.en: II-C Synthetic Bi-Temporal Data Generation
blocks.zh: II-C 合成双时 数据生成

blocks.en: Synthetic data reduce the cost of collecting temporal pairs. Changen simulates semantic changes from a single image and semantic map, and Changen2 extends the process with a diffusion Transformer [ 34 , 35 ] . HySCDG combines real and generated imagery with semantic maps and change masks [ 36 ] . WHU-GCD, RDF-MIG, and SNV-GenCD use vision–language, diffusion, or structural priors to generate paired images and spatial labels [ 37 , 38 , 39 ] . These labels are then used as detector supervision.
blocks.zh: 合成数据降低了收集时间配对的成本. Changen从单一的图像和语义映射模拟语义变化,changen2用扩散变形器延长了过程[34,35]. HySCDG将真实和生成的图像与语义图和变换口罩相结合[36]. WHU-GCD,RDF-MIG,以及SNV-GenCD使用视觉语言,传播,或结构前缀生成配对的图像和空间标签[37,38,39]. 这些标签随后被用作探测器监督.

blocks.en: General image generation has also extended to image editing, where user guidance controls changes to an existing image. SDEdit uses a diffusion prior for guided editing [ 40 ] . Blended Diffusion combines text guidance with a selected edit region [ 41 ] , while Prompt-to-Prompt controls edits through cross-attention maps [ 42 ] . These methods motivate local control, but do not by themselves define a remote-sensing transition dataset. Such a dataset requires the source class, target class, edit region, and retained caption to describe the same land-cover event.
blocks.zh: 一般图像生成也扩展到了图像编辑,用户引导控制到一个已有图像的改变. SDEDit在引导编辑前使用扩散[40]. Blended Difusion将文本指导与选定的编辑区域[41]合并,同时快速到Prompt控制通过交叉注意地图编辑[42]. 这些方法激发了局部控制,但本身并不定义遥感转换数据集。 这样的数据集需要源类,目标类,编辑区,并保留标题来描述相同的土地覆盖事件.

blocks.en: We develop a text-guided image editing pipeline for remote sensing to construct Flair-RSGen. Each change caption specifies a source-to-target land-cover transition. The pipeline generates the corresponding image pair. It also produces corresponding change masks and semantic masks for evaluation.

blocks.en: IV-C Generation Quality and Reliability of Flair-RSGen

blocks.en:
We first test whether the generator produces realistic, localized edits. We use InstructPix2Pix (IP2P), a diffusion-based model that edits images following text instructions, as the baseline [ 48 ] . Both methods are evaluated on 10,000 image pairs using
the same source images and editing instructions.
We measure distributional fidelity using the
Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) [ 49 ] ,
with real FLAIR imagery as the reference.

(LPIPS) [ 50 ] is reported separately
for changed and unchanged regions to assess the extent
of editing and background preservation. Reading the measures together distinguishes realistic appearance, local control, and recognizable land-cover content.

blocks.en: Table III shows that Flair-RSGen reduces FID from 158.83 to 8.21 compared with IP2P, indicating a generated image distribution closer to real FLAIR imagery. Changed-region LPIPS increases from 0.516 to 0.554, while background LPIPS decreases from 0.528 to 0.138. Together, these results indicate stronger edits within the intended region and better preservation of the surrounding scene. The fixed segmentation model achieves 50.6% mIoU and 71.7% pixel accuracy, compared with 21.7% and 41.3% for IP2P, suggesting that the generated land-cover classes are more recognizable. These scores also approach those on real FLAIR imagery (59.9% mIoU and 78.3% pixel accuracy), although a gap remains. Overall, the results support the visual realism, spatial control, and semantic consistency of Flair-RSGen.
blocks.zh: 表三显示,与IP2P相比,Flair-RSGen将FID从158.83减少到8.21,表明生成的图像分布更接近真实的FLAIR图像. 变化区LPIPS从0.516增加到0.554,而背景LPIPS则从0.528减少到0.138. 这些结果表明,预定区域内的编辑工作更加有力,周边景色得到更好的保护。 固定分区模型实现50.6%mIoU和71.7%像素精度,而IP2P的精度分别为21.7%和41.3%,这表明生成的土地覆盖类更能识别. 这些分数也接近真实的FLAIR图像(59.9% mIoU和78.3%像素精度)的分数,尽管差距仍然存在. 总的来说,结果支持了Flair-RSGen的视觉现实主义,空间控制和语义一致性.

blocks.en: We report image-wise macro IoU, precision, recall, and F1 on each test split. Metrics are computed per image and averaged. For a nonempty mask, binary definitions apply. For an empty reference mask, a metric equals one only if the prediction is empty; otherwise it equals zero. This rule evaluates localization and no-change rejection in the same score.
blocks.zh: 我们在每次测试分拆时报告图像的宏IoU,精度,召回和F1. 每个图像都计算和平均计量。 对于非空面具,适用二进制定义. 对于一个空的参考面罩,如果预测是空的,一个度量等于一个;否则等于零. 本规则评价同一分数的本地化和不变拒绝.

blocks.en: Image-wise averaging gives each pair equal weight and prevents large changed regions from dominating the score. We use the same empty-mask convention for every compared method. The protocol therefore measures both spatial overlap on changed pairs and complete rejection on no-change pairs.
blocks.zh: 图像平均值使每对都具有相等的重量,防止大面积变化的区域占据分数. 我们使用同样的 空面具常规 对于每一种比较的方法。 因此,协议既衡量已改变对的空间重叠,又衡量不改变对的完全拒绝。

blocks.en: Table IV examines whether captions are needed only for pseudo-mask generation or also for detector learning. We compare plain and text-conditioned detectors trained with the same pseudo labels. The plain detector receives no sample-specific caption information and uses no auxiliary semantic loss. The conditioned variant with L sem = 0 L_{\mathrm{sem}}=0 allows us to examine text conditioning separately from this loss.
blocks.zh: 表四审查是否只为假任务生成需要标题,还是也为探测器学习需要标题。 我们比较了训练有素和文字条件的探测器 和同样的假标签。 平面探测器不接收特定样本标题信息,也不使用辅助语义损失. L sem = 0 L_{\ mathrm{sem}}=0 的有条件变体,允许我们从此损失中分别检查文本调制.

blocks.en:
Using captions only to generate pseudo labels does not fully exploit their semantic information. With the agreement labels, adding text conditioning without L sem L_{\mathrm{sem}} raises IoU/F1 from 61.83/69.40 to 72.84/80.48 on Flair-RSGen, and from 17.27/20.22 to 81.59/84.31 on WHU-CDC. The pseudo labels and loss objective are unchanged
in these comparisons. The gains therefore show that the detector benefits from knowing which source-to-target transition it should detect, even when the training masks already come from captions.
blocks.zh:
仅使用标题生成伪标签并不能充分利用其语义信息. 使用协议标签,在不添加 L sem L_{\mathrm{sem} 的情况下添加文本条件,将IoU/F1 从 关于Flair-RSGen的61.83/69.40至72.84/80.48,关于WHU-CDC的17.27/20.22至81.59/84.31。 伪标签和损失目标不变
在这些比较中。 因此,这些成果表明,探测器从了解它应探测到的哪一个源到目标过渡中受益,即使训练口罩已经来自标题。

blocks.en: Appearance agreement further improves results when the detector uses caption information. With the conditioned detector and training objective fixed, replacing semantic-only labels with agreement labels improves IoU/F1 by 6.45/6.31 percentage points on Flair-RSGen and 0.97/1.14 points on WHU-CDC. The same improvement is not observed for plain detectors. These results support using agreement supervision and text conditioning together: the teacher identifies regions supported by both cues, while the detector retains the transition semantics during prediction.
blocks.zh: 外观协议在探测器使用字幕信息时会进一步改善效果. 在设定条件的探测器和训练目标固定后,用协议标签取代语义专用的标签将IoU/F1改进为Flair-RSGen的6.45/6.31个百分点,WHU-CDC的0.97/1.14个百分点. 平面探测器没有观察到同样的改进。 这些结果支持使用协议监管和文本调节一起进行:老师确定两个提示支持的区域,而探测器在预测时保留过渡语义.

blocks.en: The auxiliary semantic loss has a relatively smaller effect. Adding L sem L_{\mathrm{sem}} improves Flair-RSGen IoU/F1 from 72.84/80.48 to 73.22/80.83, while WHU-CDC remains nearly unchanged at 81.55/84.28. Thus, the main benefit comes from text conditioning; the additional gain from semantic supervision depends on the dataset.
blocks.zh: 辅助语义损失的影响相对较小. 加入L sem L_{\mathrm{sem}} 改进了Flair-RSGen IoU/F1,从72.84/80.48到73.22/80.83,而WHU-CDC在81.5/84.28时几乎保持不变. 因此,主要的好处来自文本条件;语义监督的额外收益取决于数据集.

blocks.en: IV-F 1 Semantic and Appearance Evidence
blocks.zh: IV-F 1 语义和外观证据

blocks.en: Table V isolates the internal evidence-fusion choices. RGB difference alone misses caption-relevant changes. Arithmetic fusion reaches high recall but is expansive. Geometric agreement improves IoU and F1 over arithmetic fusion by 2.56 and 2.40 points because either branch can suppress an unsupported response.
blocks.zh: 表五隔离了内部证据组合的选择. RGB 差异本身错过了与标题相关的更改 。 算术核聚变达到很高的召回,但范围很广。 几何协议将IoU和F1比算术聚变改进2.56和2.40分,因为任何一个分支都可以压制一个不支持的响应.

blocks.en: Fig. 5 illustrates how the two cues complement each other. Semantic responses highlight the named concepts but also cover nearby unchanged regions, while RGB differences help locate appearance changes without distinguishing their classes. Arithmetic fusion can carry these unsupported responses into the final map. By requiring agreement between the two cues, SAAF suppresses them and produces a more focused response around the vegetation edits shown in the figure. This visual comparison helps explain the IoU and F1 gains over arithmetic fusion reported in Table V .
blocks.zh: 图5说明了这两个提示如何相互补充。 语义反应强调命名的概念,但也涵盖附近的未变区域,而RGB差异帮助定位外观变化而不区分其类别. 算术聚变可以将这些无支持的响应带入最终地图. 通过要求两个提示之间达成协议,SAAF压制它们,并围绕图所示的植被编辑产生更集中的反应. 这一视觉比较有助于解释表五中所报告的IoU和F1在算术聚变方面的收益。

blocks.en: Replacing TCL-DA with the original TCL checkpoint while keeping Eqs. ( 9 )–( 23 ) fixed reduces IoU by 1.38 points and F1 by 1.63 points. Although the original model gives higher precision, its lower recall shows that domain-adapted cross-modal responses cover aerial objects more completely.

blocks.en: IV-F 3 Objective Design
blocks.zh: 目标设计

blocks.en: On Flair-RSGen, the map loss alone gives the highest recall but lower IoU and F1, suggesting that it recovers most changes at the cost of more false positives. Adding semantic alignment improves IoU and F1 by 0.49 and 0.58 percentage points, indicating a modest benefit from preserving source–target semantics during training. Dice brings larger gains of 1.54 and 1.57 points, consistent with its role in improving overlap between predictions and pseudo masks. Combining both terms gives the best IoU and F1 on Flair-RSGen, showing that semantic alignment and overlap supervision provide complementary benefits. However, removing L sem L_{\mathrm{sem}} leaves WHU-CDC performance nearly unchanged in Table IV , so its benefit is not consistent across datasets.

blocks.en: Table VI varies τ \tau from 0.15 to 0.35. Macro IoU and F1 vary by only 0.54 and 0.53 percentage points, respectively, indicating that SAAF is stable across this threshold range. blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: The experiments reveal two complementary stages in caption-guided change localization. TCL-DA identifies the named transition, whereas RGB difference supplies direct evidence of temporal variation. Geometric agreement retains responses supported by both cues. Unlike arithmetic fusion, it prevents a strong response in one branch from compensating for weak evidence in the other.
blocks.zh: 实验揭示了字幕引导变化本地化的两个互补阶段. TCL-DA识别出命名的过渡,而RGB差异则提供时间变化的直接证据. 几何协议保留了两个提示支持的响应. 与算术聚变不同,它阻止一个分支的强烈反应来补偿另一个分支的弱证据.

blocks.en: Caption semantics remain useful after pseudo-mask construction. The matched controls show that agreement labels are most effective when the decoder receives the ordered source, target, and difference tokens. Cross-attention preserves the requested transition during spatial refinement, while ℒ sem \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{sem}} provides light, dataset-dependent regularization. This coupling accounts for the strong caption-conditioned agreement results on both datasets.
blocks.zh: 标题语义学在假面具构建后仍然有用. 匹配的控件显示,当解码器收到指令源,目标,和差号时,协议标签最为有效. 交叉意向在空间完善期间保留了请求的过渡,而L sem\mathcal{L}_{\ mathrm{sem}提供光,数据集依赖的规范化. 这种组合说明两个数据集都有严格的附带条件的说明的协议结果。

blocks.en: Flair-RSGen contributes controllable transitions and no-change hard negatives. Its distributional and semantic checks, together with the independent WHU-CDC evaluation, show that the framework can learn from generated pairs.
blocks.zh: Flair-RSGen促进可控过渡和无变硬负数. 它的分布式和语义性检查,连同独立的WHU-CDC评价,表明框架可以从生成的对子中学习.

blocks.en: The framework also suggests clear extensions. Uncertainty-aware refinement could sharpen boundaries under registration offsets or gradual transitions. Multi-transition parsing could support captions containing several events, and broader geographic evaluation could further characterize transfer.
blocks.zh: 该框架还建议明确延长。 不确定因素的改进可能使登记所抵消的界限或逐步过渡的界限更加狭窄。 多过渡分析可以支持包含若干事件的说明,更广泛的地理评价可以进一步说明转让的特点。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en:
We presented SAAF , a semantic–appearance framework that turns change captions into supervision for remote sensing change detection, eliminating the need for manually annotated change masks during detector training. Frozen TCL-DA and RGB variation jointly construct spatial supervision, and the detector reuses ordered transition semantics through cross-attention. We also developed a caption-driven image generation pipeline to build Flair-RSGen at scale, producing controlled land-cover transitions and realistic no-change variations with paired captions, semantic maps, and change masks. The experiments demonstrate effective caption-guided learning on
Flair-RSGen and independently evaluate SAAF on observed
bi-temporal imagery from WHU-CDC. The matched controls further confirm that agreement-based pseudo supervision and caption-conditioned decoding form a complementary supervision path, with ℒ sem \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{sem}} acting as a light regularizer. Future work will extend the framework to boundary uncertainty, multiple transitions, and broader geographic settings.
